subject: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment

Team — attaching a one-pager and the latest timeline. This is the version I want summarized for the QBR deck by Friday. High level asks: 

- Can each of you highlight (in 2-3 bullets) the top 3 delivery risks for your area that could change the launch window? Mark any that are customer-impacting (see CSV).
- For items that are at risk of slipping, propose one specific mitigation (owner + ETA) we can call out in the QBR.
- If you believe scope reduction is necessary to hit our committed date for the pilot, suggest exactly what to cut (minimal viable ship) and the customer impact.

Attachments: QBR_one_pager_v1.pdf, launch_timeline_v3.xlsx, customer_impact_matrix.csv

I plan to brief Exec on Tue; need consolidated inputs by end-of-day Thu so I can bake the deck Friday morning.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment

On 2027-10-02 Vivek Kulkarni wrote:
> Team — attaching a one-pager and the latest timeline. This is the version I want summarized for the QBR deck by Friday.

Thanks — uploaded updated timeline (launch_timeline_v3.xlsx) with swimlanes and a short-risk column. Quick summary from Product POV: 

1) Scope creep on multi-model routing (MVP had simple routing rules; new requests add two complex policy flows). Risk: slips launch by 3+ weeks if we implement now. Proposed mitigation: defer advanced routing (track as v1.1) and ship with configurable default routes only. Owner: Laura. ETA for deferral decision: 2027-10-05.

2) Billing + metering changes required for Dedicated customers. Risk: procurement for pilot customers blocked until billing contract finalized. Mitigation: ship pilot with usage caps + manual billing for earliest customers; parallel PR for automated metering. Owner: Karthik. ETA: 2027-10-12.

3) Integration tests with NEXA Health show intermittent KV cache invalidation at scale (seen in staging). Risk: customer-facing latency spikes. Mitigation: infra short-term patch + increased monitoring; longer term fix in runtime release v2.3. Owner: Aditya. ETA (patch): 2027-10-08.

I attached the marked-up timeline and included the recommended scope reduction bullets under the "MVP cuts" tab.

-Laura
Senior Director, Product

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment

Laura — quick infra note on the NEXA KV cache flake: we have a reproducer for the race condition (staging) that correlates with long prefix caches and variable sequence length. Short-term patch is small but requires a short maintenance window (~30m) and a config toggle to throttle cache size. Risk to launch: medium (customer-visible if unpatched).

Mitigation plan:
- Roll patch to staging by 2027-10-05, run 48h soak.
- If clean, schedule a 30m maintenance window during off-peak for pilot customers on 2027-10-09 (owner: Aditya).

If patch doesn't hold, fallback plan is to route NEXA pilot traffic to an isolated pool (higher cost) while we complete the kernel-level fix in v2.3 (slip +4 weeks).

I'll keep the telemetry flag on so we can measure before/after.

— Aditya
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, David Jones <david.jones@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment

Vivek — pulling this together from CS and the pilot contacts at NEXA. For full transparency I'm adding David here so NEXA sees the mitigation we're planning. Short customer-impact summary: 

- NEXA depends on predictable latencies for realtime triage; current staging spikes are concerning. They have a hard SLA requirement for 99th percentile latency.
- If we do the isolated-pool fallback, NEXA accepts the temporary cost uplift but needs a clear timeline for the kernel fix and an SLA mitigation note.

David: can you confirm NEXA's willingness to accept the isolated-pool approach for the pilot and whether we should formalize an SLA addendum for the trial window?

Internal asks:
- Confirm the maintenance window 2027-10-09 (Aditya) so CS can coordinate customer notification.
- Laura: confirm scope deferral decision by COB 2027-10-05 so we can freeze features for the pilot branch.

Thanks — Monica
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: nexa-platform-team@nexahealth.com
Date: 2027-10-05T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot note: short maintenance window proposal (context)

Team at NEXA — following up with our internal plan; we propose a 30-minute maintenance window to apply a patch that should remove the KV cache inconsistency. We'll send a formal maintenance advisory once the window is locked.

Best,
Monica

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, David Jones <david.jones@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep: roadmap timing, launch risk digest & customer impact assessment

Appreciate the rapid turn-around and clear asks. Decisions/next steps I want in the QBR deck and exec briefing: 

1) Launch scope: approve Laura's recommendation to defer advanced multi-model routing to v1.1; ship pilot with default routing only. (Decision: APPROVED)
2) NEXA mitigation: proceed with Aditya's patch + 30m maintenance window on 2027-10-09; if any remaining instability, route NEXA to isolated pool until v2.3. Monica to confirm customer acceptance and sign-off on isolated-pool fallback. (Decision: APPROVED)
3) Billing: Karthik to present manual billing cadence + timeline to automate by 2027-10-12. For the pilot, use usage caps and manual invoicing. (Decision: CONDITIONAL — Karthik to confirm logistics today.)

Monica — please send a short note to David confirming the maintenance window and the fallback option; Laura — I'll include the scope decision in the deck and call it out on Tuesday.

Thanks all. I'll consolidate language for the QBR slide and share a final deck link by Monday morning.

Vivek
VP, Product & GTM
Redwood Inference
